title: No test coverage for runStarsync orchestration function — nice-to-have
description: Verified: test/index.test.ts — tests cover parseArgs, resolveTargetPath, listFolders, and stripQuotes but not the main `runStarsync` function exported from src/index.ts:112. runStarsync orchestrates the full sync flow (arg parsing → env loading → target resolution → folder listing → GitHub API fetch → clone/pull loop → summary). The function is the primary exported entry point and has zero test coverage. Mocking would require stubbing Octokit and execFileSync.
spec:
1. Add a new describe block in test/index.test.ts for `runStarsync`.
2. Test cases: (a) missing GITHUB_TOKEN → exit code 1, (b) --help flag → exit code 0 and help text printed, (c) unknown argument → exit code 2, (d) successful sync with mocked Octokit and git → exit code 0, (e) partial failure (one clone fails) → exit code 1 with failure summary.
3. Use `bun:test`'s `mock` to stub `execFileSync` and Octokit's paginate method.
